During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Azzameen family]] underwent a '''mission''' to acquire a supply of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] from the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], aboard the ''[[Vasudra]]''. During the trade, they were ambushed by a [[Loose Cannon pirates|pirate band]] who sought to capture the family for unknown reasons, but the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were defeated.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
